errors.evidence: The description incorrectly assumes that the values are percentages. The y-axis is not labeled with any units, and the sum of the values on the bars (12 + 40 + 1 + 43 + 9 = 105) indicates that they are likely counts of respondents, not percentages.

errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос представя четири категорийни отговора: „Да, напълно.“, „Не мога да преценя.“, „Не, изобщо.“ и „По-скоро да;“, като последният етикет е означен като „(blank)“.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that there are four categories. The chart clearly shows five categories with bars. The category "По-скоро не;" is completely omitted from the description. Additionally, it incorrectly claims that the last label is "(blank)", which is a separate label on the axis with no corresponding bar.
This is a repetition of the error of assuming the y-axis values are percentages, when no unit is specified in the chart.
The description fails to mention the category "По-скоро не;" and its corresponding value of 9.
This is a third instance of the error of assuming the data represents percentages ('percentage participation'), which is an interpretation not supported by explicit labels on the chart.
